Due to the Hanno Summer Festival, the Okumussashi Hanno Tourism Association will be closed on Saturday, July 18 and Sunday, July 19, 2026 (Reiwa 8) for phone inquiries and information services. During these dates, we cannot process Eagle Bus pass purchases or distribute manhole cards. The Pratto Hanno tourism information desk at Hanno Station will continue operating as usual.
